title: Sugar You Manage for Years, and a Thyroid That Storms

questions.stem: An A1C under 7% in the 2026 standards fits:

options.text: Many nonpregnant adults without severe hypoglycemia
Only people on a continuous monitor

questions.explanation: It is not a law for frailty or when lows do more harm.

questions.stem: A lower goal such as under 6.5% may fit someone who is:
questions.explanation: Loosen the goal when treatment harm is greater than benefit.

questions.stem: For many adults, the before-meal glucose range is:
questions.explanation: The peak after a meal for many adults stays under 180 mg/dL.

questions.stem: Time in range above 70% is a goal for:

options.text: Many nonpregnant adults using a continuous monitor

questions.explanation: Time under 70 mg/dL should stay under 4%, or under 1% in older adults. Time under 54 should stay under 1%.

questions.stem: In type 2 diabetes with heart failure, reduced or preserved, an SGLT2 inhibitor is:

options.text: Delayed until the A1C is under 7
Recommended, including to prevent heart-failure hospitalizations, regardless of A1C

questions.explanation: That recommendation is grade A. It is not a prize for already reaching the A1C goal.

questions.stem: Thyroid storm in the 2016 ATA guideline is diagnosed by:
questions.explanation: A Burch-Wartofsky score of 45 or more supports storm. 25 to 44 is clinical judgment. Under 25 makes storm unlikely.

questions.stem: Modern series put storm mortality at:

options.text: Zero if a beta blocker is given

questions.explanation: Do not send this person home to trend a lab.

questions.stem: In storm, propylthiouracil is preferred over methimazole because it:

options.text: Also slows conversion of T4 to T3

questions.explanation: The table load is 500 to 1000 mg, then 250 mg every 4 hours.

options.text: One hour after the antithyroid drug

questions.explanation: Five drops every 6 hours. Giving iodine first can feed the gland.

questions.stem: Hydrocortisone in the storm table is:

options.text: A 300 mg intravenous load, then 100 mg every 8 hours
A substitute for the beta blocker

questions.explanation: Propranolol in the same table is 60 to 80 mg every 4 hours, with caution if the heart is failing.
